svg.title: RIEMANN-MASULLO-DIAGRAMS DC — Appendix C · AppC_LCTVS, declaration by declaration
svg.desc: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,197 declarations of the 190 items on CC, each with its kind, file, line and state; 133 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: riemann-masullo at 72a10ff: the 1,197 declarations of the 190 items on CC, each with its kind, file, line and state; 133 declarations with a Deviation: line, quoted; and the items of other directories each item uses.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Posters: M1, what the targets rest on · M2, the steps with no known repair · M3, the paper by depth · M4, every chapter · M5, the refutations. Names, items, files, entries and posters are links, underlined under the pointer: a card's title or a Lean name opens the source at the pin.

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How to read it. The expansion of CC's cards, in the same order: one block per item, its heading opening the card. First the declarations whose docstring states how the Lean departs from the print, each with its Deviation: line quoted from the Lean source (Apache-2.0), then every declaration of the item. A name opens its line at the

text.font-family: 'RD Noto Sans', 'RD Noto Sans Math', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pin. A declaration's state is read from the terms: open when it uses sorryAx, resting when something open is below it. That a declaration states what its Deviation: line says is the docstring's claim, not checked here.

g.text: This is the general form stated immediately after (1)–(2) on the same page. For a closed subspace, equality of these topologies is the limit subspace condition. The specialization to nuclear stages uses Example C.1.5.10.

g.text: The page makes this a normed space with the norm of (C.3.6.4). Here it is a submodule of the bounded operators, so the norm and the topology that Lean supplies on it are those of the operator norm. The norm of (C.3.6.4) is schattenNorm, and every statement about that norm or its topology has to name it.

g.text: Nuclearity is proved here (nuclear_hilbertSchmidt_comp); the existing statement hilbertTrace_integralKernelOperator_comp takes it as a hypothesis. Theorem C.3.7.1(2)(b), p. 708, is a different statement: it asserts a smoothed diagonal for the kernel of one nuclear operator, and nothing here is about smoothing.

g.text: The page says only that each scalar evaluation "is an element of C^k(Ω)" and does not say whether the derivatives are real or complex. They are complex here, as Theorem C.5.2.6(2) and (C.5.2.6) require: with real derivatives complex conjugation would qualify at every order without being holomorphic. Order zero is allowed as well.
